attacks.name: Mental Blast
attacks.notes: Perception-range Damage 10 (mental); uses Will instead of Toughness

powers.name: Mind Control
powers.notes: Alternate effect of Mental Blast; dazed+compelled / controlled

powers.name: Telekinesis
powers.notes: Alternate effect of Mental Blast; ~6 tons

powers.name: Psychic Shield
powers.notes: Sustained; mental force barrier. Toughness = Sta 1 + Protection 5 = 6

specialAbilities.name: Perception Range
specialAbilities.description: Mental Blast and Mind Control require no attack roll; targets make a Will resistance check (DC 20).

specialAbilities.name: Will-based Defense
specialAbilities.description: Relies on Will (14) as primary defense. Physically frail; vulnerable to Toughness-targeting attacks.

specialAbilities.name: Sustained Shield
specialAbilities.description: Psychic Shield is sustained; if stunned, Toughness drops to 1.
